content: HA tuya climate.py maps thermostat categories: wk (heat/cool), kt (cool AC), qn (heat pump), rs (radiator), wkf, dbl (electric heater). DPCodes temp_set (target), temp_current (current). Scaling via IntegerTypeData: scaled = raw / (10**scale). Unit conversion via TemperatureConverter when device unit differs from HA. HVAC modes mapped via enum DPCode 'mode'. Switch-only devices toggle OFF/designated-mode.
